instruction: I bought a few H&M Turtleneck Sweaters on amazon this week. But only the one in extra-small size fits me well. Initiate a return for the rest. Prefer USPS as a deliverer, if available.
notes: Single-app (amazon) task. The agent lists this week's orders matching the sweater query (show_orders makes the order id known), inspects the order to learn the product ids and sizes of the three sweater variants, looks up deliverers to get USPS's id, and initiates a return (quantity 1) for each sweater that is not extra-small. The extra-small variant is marked static (fits ...) so initiate-return is only applicable to the other two. One order containing all three sweaters is assumed; if the sweaters span several orders, show-orders/show-order simply repeat per order. USPS is assumed available (deliverer-available/preferred-deliverer); the runtime fallback to another deliverer is noted in bindings since STRIPS cannot branch. supervisor-complete-task takes the two return records as non-API parameters so its precondition mirrors the goal; it carries no answer because the task is not a question.

plan: (supervisor-complete-task order-sweaters-1 sweater-other-1 order-sweaters-2 sweater-other-2 usps quantity-1)
